lines.trans: I want to set up a meeting with Steven Spielberg, who is in Paris.
He's preparing a movie about the Hundred Years' War.
So call back quickly. Have a nice day.
Spielberg? Yeah...
Hello, Julie? Where are you?
Can we go back to the set?
Samir says he has some good takes. We can catch up on the delay.

lines.trans: Sorry, Didier, but that's not an excuse.
They're going to say we're irresponsible again.
We gave it our all yesterday, didn't we?
You really must go back to the set.
All right.
Didier, you're on parole! The custody of your children!
Was that okay? Was it not too much?
No, it was wonderful.
I wanted to ask you something. Are you seeing anyone at the moment?
